ko: 나의 안에 거하라 나는 네 하나님이니 모든
en: For I am the Lord your God, so abide in MeYour Deliverer and Protector, a Shelter from the storm
Don’t tremble with fear. Surely, I will help you
I am holding your hand, so do not be afraid.
I have called you by name; you are Mine
and I am the Lord your God
You are precious in My sight and you are highly honored I, the Lord your God love you
